$comment: Cross-SDK conformance vectors for mapping the OpenAI Responses API's server-sent events onto IndeRun's canonical provider stream events. The Web, Swift, and Kotlin OpenAI adapters each implement this mapping separately, so they are held to one set of vectors rather than three hand-written suites that could drift. 'sse' is the raw response body as the streaming HTTP host capability would deliver it; 'expected' is the provider-shaped event sequence the adapter must produce, which the engine then normalizes into canonical StreamEvents. An expected entry of kind 'error' names the mapped IndeRun error class and message rather than a provider payload, since that mapping is the point of the case.

cases.name: deltas_then_completed
cases.description: The common path: text deltas, then a completed response carrying the final text and usage.

cases.name: incomplete_maps_to_length
cases.description: A run truncated by max_output_tokens completes with finishReason 'length', matching what Mode 1 reports for the same response.

cases.name: unknown_event_types_are_ignored
cases.description: The Responses event set is open and additive, so unrecognized types must not fail the run.

cases.name: output_array_shape_is_walked
cases.description: A completed response that carries its text in the output array rather than output_text resolves the same way.

cases.name: rate_limit_error_event
cases.description: Some OpenAI-compatible endpoints nest the failure under an error object on the error event; both shapes are accepted.

cases.name: root_level_error_event
cases.description: The standalone `error` event carries code and message at its root, not nested under an error object. This is the shape the OpenAI Responses streaming reference documents.
cases.sse:
event: error
data: {"type": "error", "code": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Rate limit reached for gpt-5.2", "param": null, "sequence_number": 1}

cases.name: response_failed_event
cases.description: response.failed carries its error nested under the response object.

expected.message: The model failed to generate a response.
